"""Frozen one-request causal diagnostic; no import/rebuild/publication path."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from observatory.evidence.brain import BrainEvidence,CONTAINER,isolated_argv,canonical,NativeError,safe_native_error
from observatory.evidence.contracts import load_bundle,record_digest
from observatory.python_adapter import extract_snapshot
RECEIPT=Path('observatory/evidence/receipts.json')
ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_SHA='0b0ea376ef833b32613a3c150a926f1d0867f8fc68270ce1eb904527a0d074ca'
LAST_ARGS_SHA='b41a2dbf9be43c089db4e82553d23626068f130d3c63198e68e4fff887cb8a91'
ERROR_SHA='f6e1c100ff429eeb582dc0ca422064fc38802b2fd0ae9d9fdb2b476b0fe569c3'
SNAPSHOT_SHA='a2b5010a8955cc73780d696dbbb449dc67e44da0bc9f5effbb70c64c67ffdc36'
BINARY_SHA='631de1401390e53ecccf643586879097e23b363a7afea56374e95188f63def78'
QUAL_SHA='d10c3a91b9f309624a94fd5fdfe974263e93743d28174d3b243c1c59f636aa1e'
def preflight():
 info=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker','inspect',CONTAINER],timeout=5))[0]
 assert info['Id']==CONTAINER and not info['State']['Running']
 assert info['Config']['User']=='1001:1001' and info['HostConfig']['NetworkMode']=='none'
 assert info['HostConfig']['ReadonlyRootfs'] and not info['HostConfig']['Privileged'] and not info['HostConfig']['PortBindings']
 assert info['Image']=='sha256:cf134a767f474095eeba57e0117be8e568e011a63f33fbf252f14c9b760f8e6f'
 expected={'/opt/brain':(Path('/home/genie/.brain/bin'),False),'/qualification/sandbox':(Path.cwd()/'integrations/brain/qualification/sandbox',True),'/var/lib/postgresql/data':(Path.cwd()/'integrations/brain/qualification/sandbox/pgdata',True),'/licensed-sources':(Path.cwd()/'investigations/frontier-economics/licensed-sources',False)}
 assert len(info['Mounts'])==4 and {m['Destination'] for m in info['Mounts']}==set(expected)
 for mount in info['Mounts']:
  p,w=expected[mount['Destination']]
  assert mount['Type']=='bind' and Path(mount['Source']).resolve()==p.resolve() and mount['RW']==w
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path('/home/genie/.brain/bin/brain').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==BINARY_SHA
 return info

def main():
 result={'stage':'DIAGNOSTIC_REPAIR_1_CAUSAL_CAPTURE_ONLY','status':'BLOCKED_DIAGNOSTIC','original_failed_receipt_sha256':ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_SHA,'original_args_sha256':LAST_ARGS_SHA,'snapshot_sha256':SNAPSHOT_SHA,'new_diagnostic_PGSTART_limit':1,'storage_restart_commands_this_repair':0,'paid_model_calls':0}
 client=None
 try:
  assert hashlib.sha256(RECEIPT.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==ORIGINAL_RECEIPT_SHA
  assert hashlib.sha256(Path('web/data.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==SNAPSHOT_SHA
  qualpath=Path('integrations/brain/qualification/native-receipts.json')
  assert hashlib.sha256(qualpath.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==QUAL_SHA
  old=load_bundle(RECEIPT)
  assert old['status']=='BLOCKED_WIDEN' and old['custody']['running'] is False
  bundle=extract_snapshot(load_bundle('web/data.json'),ingested_at='2026-10-09T19:02:47.018224Z',computed_at='2026-10-09T19:02:47.018288Z')
  assert record_digest(bundle)=='6f78e23589b5e07ce344daa4611aba2347e50086105998cc7f25385065140539'
  record=bundle['replay_manifests'][0]
  args={'brain_id':'brn_63n8pr','content':canonical(record),'scope':'global','veracity':'imported','source':record['id'],'extract':False,'extract_entities':False,'operation_key':'oi7:'+hashlib.sha256(record['id'].encode()).hexdigest(),'actor':'issue-7-engineer','reason':'Admitted isolated investigation evidence import','metadata':{'application_id':record['id'],'collection':'replay_manifests','canonical_sha256':record_digest(record),'provenance':None}}
  assert record_digest(args)==LAST_ARGS_SHA and len(canonical(record).encode())==6241702
  result.update(target_application_id=record['id'],target_collection='replay_manifests',target_content_utf8_bytes=6241702,operation_key=args['operation_key'])
  fixture='LAB_ONLY_'+'private_credential'
  text='postgresql://local:'+fixture+'@127.0.0.1/db Authorization: Bearer secret_header token=secret_query /home/private/person/file '+fixture+' "Authorization": "opaque_header"'
  probes=[safe_native_error({'content':[{'type':'text','text':text}]},(fixture,)),safe_native_error({'error':{'code':'LAB_CODE','message':'X'*8190+fixture}},(fixture,))]
  assert all(x not in canonical(probes) for x in (fixture,'secret_header','secret_query','opaque_header','/home/private/person/file'))
  assert probes[1]['complete'] is False
  result['bounded_redaction_lab_guards']=True
  qual=load_bundle(qualpath)
  original=[{**b,'application_id':ident,'brain_id':'brn_63n8pr'} for ident,b in qual['bindings'].items()]
  assert len(original)==26 and any(b['memory_id']=='20' for b in original)
  protected=original+[old['historical_v1_binding'],old['binding']]
  assert [b['memory_id'] for b in protected[-2:]]==['200','201']
  preflight()
  result['diagnostic_start_attempted']=True
  subprocess.run(['docker','start',CONTAINER],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=20)
  result['diagnostic_start_command_succeeded']=True
  subprocess.run(['docker','exec','-u','1001:1001',CONTAINER,'pg_isready','-h','/qualification/sandbox/socket','-U','oi5_owner','-d','brain','-t','5'],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=10)
  result['one_readonly_PG_ready_probe']=True
  client=BrainEvidence(isolated_argv(),brain_id='brn_63n8pr')
  before={b['application_id']:record_digest(client.get(b)) for b in protected}
  result['one_original_request_attempted']=True
  try:
   response=client.call('brain_remember',args)
   binding={'brain_id':client.brain_id,'application_id':record['id'],'collection':'replay_manifests','canonical_sha256':record_digest(record),'memory_id':response['memory_id'],'revision':response['revision']}
   assert client.get(binding)==record
   result['unexpected_success_binding']=binding
   result['status']='DIAGNOSTIC_REQUEST_SUCCEEDED_NOT_COMPLETE_SNAPSHOT'
  except NativeError as exc:
   result['actual_error_sha256']=record_digest(exc.body)
   result['same_original_error_response']=result['actual_error_sha256']==ERROR_SHA
   result['safe_native_error']=safe_native_error(exc.body,client.redactions)
   result['status']='DIAGNOSTIC_REJECTION_CAUSAL_CAPTURE_NOT_COMPLETION'
  after={b['application_id']:record_digest(client.get(b)) for b in protected}
  assert before==after
  result['original_26_and_roots_200_201_unchanged']=before
  assert len(client.calls)<=58
 except BaseException as exc:
  result['status']='BLOCKED_DIAGNOSTIC';result['error_type']=type(exc).__name__
  if isinstance(exc,NativeError):
   result['actual_error_sha256']=record_digest(exc.body)
   result['safe_native_error']=safe_native_error(exc.body,client.redactions if client else ())
 finally:
  if client:
   result['native_calls']=client.calls
   try:
    client.close()
   except BaseException as exc:
    result['status']='BLOCKED_DIAGNOSTIC';result['native_close_error_type']=type(exc).__name__
 print(canonical(result),flush=True)
 return 1 if result['status']=='BLOCKED_DIAGNOSTIC' else 0
if __name__=='__main__':
 sys.exit(main())

"""Own-child 210s limit, outer cleanup budget <300s; never a retry."""
import hashlib,json,os,runpy,signal,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from observatory.evidence.brain import CONTAINER,canonical
INNER=Path('/tmp/oi7-native-replay-diagnostic-1.py')
INNER_SHA='b5db513f707b183e534f10e4887739ba00696017ec9b969fb2466cbe94e084e0'
BRAIN_SHA='892e68d090e8b4bd01b9582cbbd50088943939289c8bf7a4caf65abcbc5edd18'
RECEIPT=Path('observatory/evidence/receipts.json')
OLD_SHA='0b0ea376ef833b32613a3c150a926f1d0867f8fc68270ce1eb904527a0d074ca'
start=time.monotonic(); deadline=start+300
assert hashlib.sha256(INNER.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==INNER_SHA
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('observatory/evidence/brain.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==BRAIN_SHA
assert hashlib.sha256(RECEIPT.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==OLD_SHA
old=json.loads(RECEIPT.read_text())
helpers=runpy.run_path(str(INNER))
# No start/child/stop if the initial exact stopped-container guard fails.
helpers['preflight']()
child=None
result={'stage':'DIAGNOSTIC_REPAIR_1_CAUSAL_CAPTURE_ONLY','status':'BLOCKED_DIAGNOSTIC','original_failed_receipt_sha256':OLD_SHA}
guard={'outer_limit_seconds':300,'child_limit_seconds':210,'inner_sha256':INNER_SHA,'actual_brain_sha256':BRAIN_SHA}
try:
 env={'PATH':os.environ.get('PATH','/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin'),'LANG':'C.UTF-8','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}
 child=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-B',str(INNER)],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,text=True,env=env,start_new_session=True)
 output,_=child.communicate(timeout=min(210,max(0,deadline-time.monotonic()-85)))
 guard['child_exit']=child.returncode
 guard['child_stdout_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(output.encode()).hexdigest()
 parsed=json.loads(output)
 assert isinstance(parsed,dict) and parsed.get('stage')=='DIAGNOSTIC_REPAIR_1_CAUSAL_CAPTURE_ONLY'
 result=parsed
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
 guard['child_deadline_exceeded']=True
except BaseException as exc:
 guard['outer_error_type']=type(exc).__name__
finally:
 # Kill only this new_session child group; no foreign processes/services.
 if child:
  try:
   if child.poll() is None:
    os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
  except ProcessLookupError:
   pass
  try:
   child.wait(timeout=5)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
   guard['child_cleanup_failed']=True
 # Unconditional exact-own stop after launch: start timeout may have started PG.
 try:
  stop=subprocess.run(['docker','stop','--time','20',CONTAINER],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=30)
  guard['stop_exit']=stop.returncode
 except BaseException as exc:
  guard['stop_error_type']=type(exc).__name__
 try:
  state=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker','inspect',CONTAINER],timeout=5))[0]
  guard['container']=state['Id'];guard['running']=state['State']['Running']
  guard['pgdata_retained']=Path('integrations/brain/qualification/sandbox/pgdata').is_dir()
 except BaseException as exc:
  guard['inspect_error_type']=type(exc).__name__
 guard['wall_seconds']=round(time.monotonic()-start,3)
 guard['verified_stopped']=guard.get('container')==CONTAINER and guard.get('running') is False and guard.get('stop_exit')==0
 if not guard['verified_stopped'] or guard['wall_seconds']>300 or guard.get('child_cleanup_failed') or guard.get('child_deadline_exceeded') or guard.get('child_exit') not in (0,):
  result['status']='BLOCKED_DIAGNOSTIC'
 result['outer_guard']=guard
 assert hashlib.sha256(RECEIPT.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==OLD_SHA
 # One owned write; original top-level BLOCKED_WIDEN and all61649calls unchanged.
 saved={**old,'diagnostic_repair_1':result}
 RECEIPT.write_text('{'+chr(10)+(','+chr(10)).join(json.dumps(k)+':'+canonical(v) for k,v in saved.items())+chr(10)+'}'+chr(10))
print(canonical({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('native_calls','original_26_and_roots_200_201_unchanged')}))
sys.exit(1 if result['status']=='BLOCKED_DIAGNOSTIC' else 0)
